name: crossllm-panel
description: Compare answers from seven independent LLM providers and synthesize a supported conclusion.

interface.shortDescription: Compare seven LLM providers in parallel
interface.longDescription: Runs one task through OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Hugging Face, Kimi, Mistral, and Grok, then guides ChatGPT to reconcile their results.
defaultPrompt: Ask the seven-model panel and synthesize the result.
Compare independent LLM opinions on this decision.
